name: mind

phase_0.boundary_condition: the criticality operator ⊙ that absorbs contradictions and maintains coherent type assignment

VINIT.chosen_element: pre-conscious awareness state before attentional focus
VINIT.justification: the void state before any cognitive process begins

TANCH.chosen_element: the stable ego-boundary that contains conscious experience
TANCH.justification: the terminal anchor that defines the boundary of the conscious system

AFWD.justification: the forward morphism representing cognitive extension into the world

AREV.justification: the reverse morphism representing withdrawal back to self-model

CLINK.chosen_element: binding of sensory inputs into unified perceptual objects
CLINK.justification: the composition operation linking distinct cognitive modules

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: the self-referential mechanism that recognizes its own operation
IMSCRIB.justification: the identity operation where mind knows it is mind

FSPLIT.chosen_element: the bifurcation between conscious and unconscious processing
FSPLIT.justification: the co-multiplication that splits processing into attended vs. background channels

FFUSE.chosen_element: the integration of consciousness with pre-conscious processing
FFUSE.justification: the multiplication that reunites conscious and unconscious streams

EVALT.chosen_element: successful recognition and validation of mental content
EVALT.justification: the true branch representing successful cognitive evaluation

EVALF.chosen_element: cognitive dissonance and invalidation of conflicting content
EVALF.justification: the false branch representing failed cognitive evaluation

ENGAGR.chosen_element: paradoxical self-awareness where observer and observed merge
ENGAGR.justification: the both state holding the paradox of mind observing itself

IFIX.chosen_element: consolidated memories that become permanently accessible
IFIX.justification: the irreversible fixation of experience into long-term memory

phase_3.void_description: the pre-conscious state before attentional selection occurs
phase_3.true_description: coherent conscious experience with validated content
phase_3.false_description: fragmented state during cognitive dissonance or error
phase_3.both_description: paradoxical awareness state where self and world boundaries dissolve

steps.domain_action: genesis of awareness as pure potential before attention
cognitive processing bifurcates into conscious and unconscious streams
attention moves outward toward external objects and stimuli
conscious validation of attended objects and recognition of patterns
self-recognition mechanism activates, mind identifies as mind
binding operation integrates multimodal inputs into unified percepts
conscious and unconscious processing streams reunite to form coherent experience
recursive loop returns attention inward for self-reflection and metacognition
rejection mechanism filters out contradictory or impossible content
paradoxical self-observation where observer and observed become indistinguishable
second-level split where self-awareness splits into subject and self-object
attention turns toward internal mental processes and their dynamics
validation of self-knowledge and understanding of own cognitive mechanisms
integration of external and internal attention into unified awareness
reunification of inner and outer attention into integrated consciousness
higher-order self-model validates its own existence as a conscious system
deep introspection enters the recursive loop of infinite self-regression
fundamental split between the knowing subject and the process of knowing
recognition of cognitive limitations and boundaries of awareness
binding of temporal sequences creates continuous narrative self
final integration of all cognitive streams into stable phenomenal consciousness
maintenance of the paradox where mind observes its own observation process
crystallization of stable self-model into enduring personality pattern
completion of conscious system with stable boundary conditions

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the attention schema theory mechanism that constructs self-model from cognitive processes
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: global workspace communication between specialized neural networks
phase_5.memory_mechanism: distributed neural binding that maintains temporal continuity across processing cycles
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the thalamocortical rhythm that orchestrates attentional timing and binding cycles
phase_5.alfs_store: the imscribed grammar lattice that determines valid transitions between conscious states

phase_6.cycle_cost: attentional resources and neural metabolic demand during binding operations
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: unbound sensory chaos with distributed processing across neural networks
phase_6.post_cycle_state: coherent conscious experience with integrated objects and stable self-model
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the binding operation conserves information while organizing it into structured consciousness
